info.name: Export test cases in CSV format

params.name: name
params.description: Name can be table FQN, test suite FQN, or '*' for platform-wide export

items.docs:
Export test cases in CSV format. You can export test cases at different levels:
- Table level: Provide table FQN to export test cases for that table
- Test suite level: Provide test suite FQN to export test cases in that test suite
- Platform-wide: Use '*' to export all test cases across the platform

info.name: Export test cases in CSV format asynchronously

params.name: name
params.description: Name can be table FQN, test suite FQN, or '*' for platform-wide export

items.docs:
Export test cases in CSV format asynchronously. You can export test cases at different levels:
- Table level: Provide table FQN to export test cases for that table
- Test suite level: Provide test suite FQN to export test cases in that test suite
- Platform-wide: Use '*' to export all test cases across the platform
